Spot Bitcoin ETFs Record $240 Million in Single-Day Net Outflows, Led by BlackRock’s IBIT at $210 Million According to SoSoValue data, on November 17 (ET), spot Bitcoin ETFs saw a total net outflow of $240 million, with BlackRock’s IBIT leading the outflows at $210 million. Meanwhile, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded a total net outflow of $29.09 million yesterday, marking their third consecutive day of net outflows. — link

Binance Plans to Enter Five Asian Markets Next Year, Focusing on South and Southeast Asia According to Reuters, Binance’s Asia-Pacific head SB Seker said the company plans to enter five Asian markets next year, focusing on South and Southeast Asia. It is in talks with five or six markets, with three at an advanced stage. The markets were not named; details are expected in the first quarter of next year. Following a $6.3 billion crypto theft last month, Binance contacted regulators in Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand and New Zealand within 36 to 48 hours. Seker said discussions with regulators on industry-wide security threats are ongoing. — link

Polygon Plans to Acquire Payment and Correspondent Banking Licences Across Multiple Markets, Budgeting $50M–$100M per Acquisition, and Is Considering a US Banking Licence According to Moneycontrol, Polygon co-founder Sandeep Nailwal said the company plans to acquire payment and correspondent banking licences over the next two years in North America, the EU, Latin America (Brazil and Mexico), Southeast Asia and other regions, budgeting around $50 million to $100 million per acquisition. It is also considering applying for a US banking licence. Polygon Labs is shifting from a blockchain infrastructure provider to an end-to-end business solutions and banking services company. Earlier this year, it acquired US digital currency payments firm Coinme and wallet infrastructure provider Sequence for around $250 million. — link

He believes 99% of today's AI startups will eventually fail, similar to the ICO and IEO boom in crypto. As attention shifts toward AI, entrepreneurs still building in crypto are more solid, making it easier to identify investment opportunities. CZ added that AI will not replace money or the internet but will use both and require more capital. He is now more bullish on crypto than ever. — link
